_comment: A/B comparison (2026-10-21), A = baseline: bands + URM puzzle embedding, nothing else. data/miniarc_pairs.npz (Mini-ARC, 149 tasks, grids <= 5x5, every task transductive as URM: its train pairs are training pairs, its test pair evaluated; 149 evaluation pairs; slots 6x6, up to 8 demonstrations). Episodes in context (up to 5 demonstrations + query, packed). URM versions: 101 per task (v = 0 identity, v >= 1 a fixed dihedral transform and permutation of colors 1..9), identifier task * 101 + v, evaluation v = 0; puzzle embedding 512 as one prefix token (angle 0), SignSGD lr 1e-2, wd 0.1, EMA. 16 blocks per segment, last block with gradients, 8 segments, batch 64. local_conv, frame_rope, rule_path off. B = A + the rule synapse fed by the same embedding (configs/miniarc_pe_rule.json).
